content.title: NVIDIA, Wingtech, Xiaomi, Big Bear: Trending Stocks
content.description:
Chinese chip company Wingtech (600745.SS) sees shares dive after the Netherlands took control of its Dutch arm. Tesla (TSLA) isn't the only EV company struggling with handle design: Xiaomi (1810.HK, XIACF) stocks fall after a tragic fatal accident. Big Bear AI (BBAI) is climbing after confirming a new contract with the U.S. Navy. And as NVIDIA (NVDA), Oracle (ORCL) and other Big AI stocks recover Friday's losses in pre-market, Applied Digital (APLD) continues to rise, powered by data center deals with CoreWeave (CRWV) and others.

For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.
